thread.document:
I got GPT 5.1 to get homework 7 working. In short, GPT 5.1 pretty much one shotted the actual coding parts, minus one small issue where it calculated MSE wrong. However after two followups to this MSE prompt, it got it correct without me specifically mentioning the issue. 

I did notice that though it was good at doing the work, it doesn't look around the code to fix potential issues, for example, the code currently had .cuda(), but I wanted it to work with mps. I had to specifically prompt it to fix that issue, though I would have hoped it did that in the first place.
